name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare5-111年老人狀況調查資料檔
data_description_en:
1. This survey was conducted pursuant to Article 10 of the Senior Citizens Welfare Act. The survey used in-person field interviews; in addition to surveying the population aged 65 and older, and following past practice, it also surveyed the population aged 55-64 (main form) in order to understand the status of the population approaching old age. This survey focused on family caregivers, and additionally surveyed the primary family caregivers (supplementary form) of persons aged 55 and older whose daily living requires assistance or care from others. This round completed 6,803 valid samples for the main form (55 and older) and 503 valid samples for the supplementary form (primary family caregivers).
2. Survey items include, for the population aged 55 and older: family and living conditions, health and self-care ability, employment and economic status, social activities, public-transportation friendliness, willingness to move into residential-care institutions and personal views, and the burden on primary family caregivers, among other data, to serve as a reference for the government in formulating elderly-related welfare policy.
3. The survey implementation plan, sampling design, and questionnaire can be found on the website of the Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare: https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html).
notes_en:
1. The questionnaire is divided into a main form (for the case sample) and a supplementary form (for primary family caregivers). To avoid affecting the response rate and quality of the main form, the primary-family-caregiver supplementary form was completed on a voluntary basis by the primary caregiver, resulting in a limited number of collected samples whose distribution may not match that of the population; please use this data with caution.
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals. The key for matching the main-form and supplementary-form file data: sample number (CASEID)
